model_annotation: The plot illustrates the number of issued permits for construction of new buildings from 2012 to 2022, separated into three categories shown as lines. The x-axis is labeled by year with tick labels for each year from 2012 г. through 2022 г., evenly spaced on a linear scale. The y-axis is not explicitly labeled in the image, but it represents counts of permits and spans values from about 70 up to 8,169 based on the annotated data labels. The blue line (Административни) is a solid line without visible markers and shows values labeled near the bottom: 170 (2012), 156 (2013), 187 (2014), 157 (2015), 163 (2016), 127 (2017), 128 (2018), 103 (2019), 95 (2020), 96 (2021), and 70 (2022), generally decreasing toward the end. The orange line (Други) is solid without visible markers and is labeled 4,938 (2012), 4,674 (2013), 4,323 (2014), 4,382 (2015), 4,685 (2016), 5,460 (2017), 4,826 (2018), 4,608 (2019), 3,944 (2020), 4,685 (2021), and 4,631 (2022), rising to 2017, dropping to 2020, then increasing in 2021 and slightly decreasing in 2022. The gray line (Жилищни) is solid without visible markers and is labeled 4,238 (2012), 4,120 (2013), 4,245 (2014), 4,310 (2015), 4,514 (2016), 5,562 (2017), 5,774 (2018), 5,980 (2019), 5,860 (2020), 7,047 (2021), and 8,169 (2022), increasing overall with a small dip at 2020 before rising sharply through 2022.
